Fifty clones stall before writing: each epoch's words hash from the previous state root, so the next challenge is unknowable until the flip and no answer can be prepped in advance. Weight climbs one unit per consecutive epoch answered, resetting after a gap.

Fifty fake voices then need fifty writers awake every six hours. Holding them at weight twenty costs 1,000 essays, near 200 hours at $15 an hour, $3,000 before one POA lands.

A zephyr slips through any fence, and a karst hollows whatever sits on it. Copper comes from staying in the seam, not from owning many shovels.
